lines.zh: 我一步步走过来，头发竖得像火。
lines.en: I advance step by step, hair standing like flame.

lines.zh: 我脚下裂开细缝，随着我的脚步。
lines.en: Thin cracks open under my steps.

lines.zh: 气托着我走，鞋底几乎不沾地。
lines.en: Ki carries me; my soles barely touch ground.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，热气还没散。
lines.en: The heat has not yet cleared where I passed.

lines.zh: 我跨得很大，落地却很轻。
lines.en: My strides are long, my landings light.

lines.zh: 我不躲不闪，径直朝你走。
lines.en: I do not dodge or weave; I come straight at you.

lines.zh: 我的气焰把地上的土吹成圈。
lines.en: My aura blows the dust into rings.
I circle the field without looking at you.

lines.zh: 我踏出一步，空气噼啪响。
lines.en: I take a step and the air crackles.

lines.zh: 我从上面落下来，再慢慢走。
lines.en: I drop from above, then walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我的步伐很稳，一点也不急。
lines.en: My pace is steady, not hurried at all.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过来，不留空子。
lines.en: I press in step by step, leaving no gap.
I stand, and my aura has not gone out.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是青色的，看着有点冷。
lines.en: My eyes are teal, and they look cold.

lines.zh: 我把气收在体表，没有外放。
lines.en: I hold my ki at my skin, not letting it loose.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬下巴，活动脖子。
lines.en: I lift my chin and roll my neck.

lines.zh: 这一身力量，用一点就够。
lines.en: A fraction of this power is enough.

lines.zh: 我没有生气，只是不想再等。
lines.en: I am not angry; I simply will not wait longer.

lines.zh: 风碰到我的气就被弹开。
lines.en: The wind hits my aura and bounces off.
The stones at my feet are hopping slightly.

lines.zh: 我在想，用几成力就够了。
lines.en: I am deciding how much of my strength will do.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很慢，气却涨得很满。
lines.en: My breathing is slow, yet my ki runs full.

lines.zh: 四周静得只剩我身上的响。
lines.en: The only sound left is the hum around me.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，又收回身侧。
lines.en: I raise a hand and bring it back to my side.

lines.zh: 头发挡住半边脸，我没去拨。
lines.en: My hair covers half my face and I leave it.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，瞳孔是青色的。
lines.en: I raise my eyes to you, pupils teal.
If you are going to move, do it now.

lines.zh: 我不笑了，这不是好玩的事。
lines.en: I am not smiling; this is no game.

lines.zh: 你的气抖了一下，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your ki fluttered; I felt it.
I step half in and my aura brightens.
Retreat, and I will still come on.
I watch you, waiting for a reason.
Your time is running short.

lines.zh: 我出手比上一形态快得多。
lines.en: I strike far faster than before.

lines.zh: 你脚下那点动作，瞒不过我。
lines.en: That little movement of your feet does not fool me.
I let my hands hang, with no stance.
I will not drag this out; one exchange.
Ki gathers in a ball at my wrist.
You can hardly hold my gaze.
I tilt my head as if listening to something.

lines.zh: 这一带的地面，我站上去就裂。
lines.en: The ground cracks where I plant my feet.
I speak, and it is a single word.
I am done holding back.
I give half a step and my aura dims.
That blow cleared my head.
There is blood at my lip; I wipe it.

lines.zh: 气焰晃了一下，又立起来。
lines.en: My aura wavers, then stands again.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，眼里结着冰。
lines.en: I look up, my eyes like ice.
I press the wound, then let go.
This much pain is nowhere near enough.
I raise my ki another notch.
You have forced me to get serious.
That means nothing to me.
I am not in the mood for it.

lines.zh: 别拿这个浪费我的时间。
lines.en: Do not waste my time with that.
Right now I want only the outcome.
Your raised hand looks ridiculous.
I have no need of this.

lines.zh: 这东西连我的气都近不了。
lines.en: It cannot even near my aura.
Put it away; do not make me say it twice.
One glance at it, and I look away.

lines.zh: 这种招数，对现在的我没用。
lines.en: Such tricks do not work on me now.
You crash into me and I do not budge.

lines.zh: 气一弹，你自己被弹开了。
lines.en: My aura flares and it is you who is thrown.
I set my forearm across and bar the way.
Touch me and it will cost you.
I did not even look at that.

lines.zh: 空气在我周围发出低响。
lines.en: The air hums low around me.
When you pull back, your hands are shaking.
That collision hurt you, not me.
I did not dodge, and I need not.

lines.zh: 再撞一次也是一样的结果。
lines.en: Once more will end the same way.

lines.zh: 这和我现在的状态无关。
lines.en: That has nothing to do with my state now.
I have no room for that.
Do not ask that again.
I look away.

lines.zh: 这种话，等我气散了再说。
lines.en: Say that when my aura has died down.

lines.zh: 我现在的心里只有一件事。
lines.en: Only one thing is on my mind now.

lines.zh: 气还没散，我没心思想这些。
lines.en: My ki is still up. I can't think of that.
I step back.
I do not care to discuss that.

lines.zh: 我伸手一抓，它就到了手里。
lines.en: I reach out and it is in my hand.
I will keep this.
I look twice and lose interest.
I set it aside carelessly.

lines.zh: 太轻了，我几乎感觉不到。
lines.en: So light I barely feel it.
I have it; do not reach for it.
I tuck it into my clothes.
Useless; throw it away.
It buys me nothing.
I raise my head and my aura bursts.
I have your position worked out.
I do not mean to wait any longer.
My ki throws the soil up.
I go straight for you.
This is fast enough.
My eyes flare bright.
You have no other choice now.

lines.zh: 我抬手，气顺着指尖出去。
lines.en: I raise a hand and ki runs from my fingertips.
Then we start now.
I close to a single step.

lines.zh: 你动的那一下，就是开始。
lines.en: That movement of yours starts it.

lines.zh: 全身的气都压到了前脚。
lines.en: All my ki loads onto my leading foot.
I smile, very briefly.
This time I will not pull back.
You had better be ready.
I stay facing you without blinking.
You are fast; I am faster.
My ki stays glued to you.

lines.zh: 你换个方向，我已经在那儿。
lines.en: You turn, and I am already there.

lines.zh: 气弹一颗接一颗地出去。
lines.en: One ki blast after another leaves my hand.

lines.zh: 我不急，我等你自己失误。
lines.en: I am patient; I wait for your mistake.
I circle half around and cut you off.

lines.zh: 地面被我的气震出一道纹。
lines.en: My aura shakes a line across the ground.

lines.zh: 你每次抬手，我都看得清。
lines.en: I see clearly each time you raise a hand.
My breathing is perfectly even.
I press you toward the rock wall.
One step closer and it is my turn.

lines.zh: 你的手在发抖，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see your hands trembling.

lines.zh: 你的每一个动作我都算过。
lines.en: I have counted every move you make.

lines.zh: 我抬手，气就锁住那片地方。
lines.en: I raise a hand and ki seals that ground.
I keep pressing forward.

lines.zh: 最后一击的角度已经找好。
lines.en: I have the angle for the last blow.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地面开花。
lines.en: I bring my fist down and the ground blossoms.

lines.zh: 蓄气突击，我撞进你怀里。
lines.en: A charged rush takes me right into you.
Meteor combo, one blow after another.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出去，气跟着走。
lines.en: I push out a palm and the ki follows.

lines.zh: 魔闪光崩出来，你来不及躲。
lines.en: Masenko bursts; you are too late to dodge.
A volley of ki blasts seals your path.
My kick sends you into the air.

lines.zh: 你挡下的那一下，让我有点意外。
lines.en: That you blocked it surprised me a little.
The fist lands before the sound catches up.

lines.zh: 我按住你的肩膀，往下一压。
lines.en: I clamp your shoulder and drive down.
I used seven tenths on that one.

lines.zh: 我收手的时候，气还在烧。
lines.en: When I draw back, the ki still burns.
This has gone on long enough.
For the last blow, everything.

lines.zh: 你站不起来了，我看得出来。
lines.en: You cannot stand again; I can see it.

lines.zh: 金色的气先亮起，然后是我。
lines.en: Golden ki lights up first, then me.

lines.zh: 我落下来，脚下碎了一片石。
lines.en: I come down and shatter a patch of stone.
The shockwave flattens the grass around me.

lines.zh: 我站直了，头发一绺绺立着。
lines.en: I straighten and my hair stands strand by strand.

lines.zh: 这片场地的空气变重了。
lines.en: The air of this field has grown heavy.
I lift my eyes, and my pupils are teal.
The hand I raised has not yet come down.

lines.zh: 地上的裂缝从脚边散开。
lines.en: Cracks spread out from my feet.
I am waiting for this body to steady.

lines.zh: 风绕着我转了一圈才散。
lines.en: The wind circles me once before scattering.
Birds startle up somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，热气是白的。
lines.en: I exhale, and my breath is white.

lines.zh: 我落地的动静，半个山谷都听见。
lines.en: Half the valley heard me land.

lines.zh: 我站定了，眼睛没离开前方。
lines.en: I settle, eyes never leaving ahead.
I raise a hand and smooth my collar.

lines.zh: 我一步踏出，石头成了粉。
lines.en: I take a step and stone becomes powder.
This is not my usual shape.
Good; it starts now.

lines.zh: 火碰到我的气就熄了，只有袖子在烧。
lines.en: Fire dies on my aura; only my sleeve burns.

lines.zh: 我砸进地里，坑比我想的深。
lines.en: I slam into the ground; the crater is deeper than I meant.

lines.zh: 水一碰我的气就沸腾，可我还是呛了口。
lines.en: Water boils against my aura, but I still choke.

lines.zh: 爆风推着我滑出去，脚跟犁开土。
lines.en: The blast sends me sliding, heels plowing soil.

lines.zh: 那东西擦过我的肋，只留下一道痕。
lines.en: It grazes my ribs and leaves only a line.

lines.zh: 一股怪力缠上我的气，我直接撕开。
lines.en: Something binds my ki; I tear it apart.

lines.zh: 气焰开始发虚，我才发觉撑太久了。
lines.en: My aura starts to thin and I realize how long I have pushed.

lines.zh: 雷砸下来，我把它吸进掌心。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; I draw it into my palm.

lines.zh: 脚下没底，我一时间找不到落点。
lines.en: There is no bottom and for a moment I find no landing.
